'''''Star-Wake''''' was an [[Envoy-class shuttle|''Envoy''-class shuttle]] that was used during rescue operations after the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]] by the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]].

==History==
The ''Star-Wake'', an [[Envoy-class shuttle|''Envoy''-class shuttle]], was a product of [[Tallaani Shipyards]]. When [[Jedi Lord]] [[Valenthyne Farfalla]] pleaded for resources for the [[New Sith Wars]], a benefactor from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] donated the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] in the final weeks of the [[Ruusan campaign]].

[[Irtanna]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the ''Star-Wake'' upon her descent to [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] on one of the Army of Light's rescue missions following the detonation of the [[thought bomb]] in the catastrophic [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]], and her crew included [[Bordon]] and his sons, [[Tallo (Star-Wake)|Tallo]] and [[Wend]]. The crew later attempted to rescue [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Zannah]], who they believed to be a war orphan, however, the young [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] had been ordered to find a way to [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], and was determined to steal their shuttle. She [[Death/Legends|murdered]] the ''Star-Wake''{{'s}} entire crew and flew the ship to Onderon to meet her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] there.

When the ''Star-Wake'' crashed onto Onderon, Zannah was met and challenged by the [[Skelda clan]], a group of [[Beast Riders]]. She was saved by Darth Bane upon his return from [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]]. Later, the ''Star-Wake'' was found floating aimlessly in the [[Japrael sector/Legends|Japrael sector]].
